title: Seattle DGX Spark Hackathon Winners Spotlight
summary: NVIDIA’s Seattle DGX Spark Hackathon showcased local AI applications built over a weekend on Acer Veriton GN100 systems powered by the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip. The highlighted winners include Kerberos, a shared spatial-awareness system that fuses responders, robots, and drones into a live search-and-rescue map, and VELA, a voice-first healthcare agent that compares care options and gates consequential actions behind explicit user consent.

extra.full_text: Join the NVIDIA Developer Community for a live interview with winning teams from the NVIDIA DGX Spark Hack in Seattle: a weekend where developers turned ambitious ideas into working applications running locally on the Acer Veriton GN100 powered by the NVIDIA GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip. Across the See, Do, and Spark tracks, teams combined vision, speech, retrieval, simulation, and agent workflows to build systems that perceive the world, take action, and run locally on GB10-powered systems. We’re sitting down with two winning teams: Kerberos, winner of the See Track, who built a shared spatial-awareness system for search-and-rescue teams that brings responders, robots, and drones into one live map — and VELA, winner of the Do Track, who built a voice-first healthcare action system that compares paths to care and requires explicit user consent before taking consequential actions. Both teams will demo their projects live, talk through how they built them, and take your questions.

summary: KNR Systems has installed a 12-meter, 20-ton Robot Taekwon V at Taekwon V Land in Muju, South Korea, built for the county using the company’s hydraulic and electric precision-control technology for heavy-duty, extreme-environment robots. The robot has 34 independent joints and hydraulic actuators, allowing it to perform movements such as front and side kicks in sync with music, turning a commemorative cultural display into a large-scale demonstration of Korean robotics engineering.

summary: BNB STEEL’s robotics division demonstrated 카우봇, an agricultural quadruped robot, for farmers in the Gijang area at Dongbusan Nonghyup’s materials center. The robot is designed to carry heavy harvest loads in farm fields, reportedly following a worker for about 30 minutes while carrying 20 kg up slopes as steep as 30 degrees, with simple tag-based operation worn at the waist.

title: 전 세계 농가 생성 AI 도입 급증…불황 속 17%가 필수 도구로 채택
summary: McKinsey’s Global Farmer Insights 2026 report says generative AI adoption is rising quickly in agriculture, with 17% of farmers worldwide already using it for farm-related tasks and business planning. The shift stands out because other ag-tech categories such as robotics and sustainability software have spread more slowly, while farmers facing inflation and volatile input costs are treating generative AI as a practical management tool rather than a distant innovation.

extra.full_text: 글로벌 농업 시장이 고물가와 원자재 가격 변동성으로 진통을 겪는 가운데, 전 세계 농부들이 경영 난관을 극복하기 위한 핵심 솔루션으로 생성 AI를 빠르게 도입하고 있다. 로봇이나 지속가능성 소프트웨어 등 기존 농업 기술의 보급이 더딘 상황에서 생성 AI가 농업 분야 내 가장 가파른 성장세를 보이며 필수 경영 도구로 자리 잡았다는 분석이다.맥킨지앤드컴퍼니가 8일(현지시간) 발표한 '글로벌 농부 인사이트 2026' 보고서에 따르면, 전 세계 농가의 17%가 이미 농업 관련 작업과 경영 계획 수립에 생성 AI를 활용하는 것으로 나타났다.
